# `to_unix_timestamp`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
to_unix_timestamp(timeExp[, fmt])
```

Returns the UNIX timestamp of the given time.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.6.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_unix_timestamp, example 1
> SELECT to_unix_timestamp('2016-04-08', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
1460098800
```
